services.name: Speech Therapy
services.shortDesc: Clear speech, pronunciation, and stuttering/fluency support for children and adults.
services.whoItHelps: Children with speech delay, clarity issues, stammering, or adult voice difficulties.

services.name: Language Therapy
services.shortDesc: Building vocabulary, sentence formation, social communication, and comprehension skills.
services.whoItHelps: Children with developmental language delays, autism spectrum, or expressive challenges.

services.name: Pediatric Therapy
services.shortDesc: Child-centric, play-based early intervention for toddlers and school-age children.
services.whoItHelps: Toddlers not yet speaking, school-age children with learning & communication barriers.

services.name: Hearing Assessment
services.shortDesc: Comprehensive pure tone audiometry and diagnostic hearing evaluations.
services.whoItHelps: Individuals experiencing hearing difficulty, ringing in ears (tinnitus), or elderly family members.

services.name: Hearing Aid Consultation & Fitting
services.shortDesc: Trial, selection, and digital programming of advanced hearing aid technologies.
services.whoItHelps: Patients with diagnosed hearing loss seeking comfortable, discreet listening solutions.

services.name: Voice Therapy
services.shortDesc: Specialized rehabilitation for vocal strain, hoarseness, and professional voice users.
services.whoItHelps: Teachers, singers, public speakers, or individuals with persistent vocal fatigue.

reviews.author: Pooja S.
reviews.text: The therapists at Saukhya are exceptionally patient and gentle with children. We noticed steady improvements in our son's speech clarity within a few months of regular sessions.

reviews.author: Rajesh M.
reviews.text: Took my mother for a hearing evaluation. The doctor explained the audiometry report clearly without rushing us or pushing unnecessary products. Very honest and warm clinic.

reviews.author: Aniket K.
reviews.text: Very professional and calm environment right in Vikhroli. Practical guidance given for speech fluency. Highly recommended for both children and adults.
